annotations.title: Prompt Cache Key & Context Budgeter API

description: Prompt Cache Key & Context Budgeter API: Estimate tokens, optimize message order for prompt caching, and calculate LLM API costs. (Endpoint: POST /v1/prompt-cache-budgeter)

blocks.description: Ordered list of prompt blocks (1 to 200) to analyze for prefix caching and context budgeting.

example.content: Analyze clause 4.2 of the attached agreement.

cacheable.description: Optional boolean cache hint (`true` treats as `static`, `false` treats as `turn` unless `volatility` is specified).

content.description: Prompt text content for this block.

id.description: Optional identifier for this prompt block (defaults to `block_<index>`).

volatility.description: Optional explicit cache volatility tier (`static`, `session`, or `turn`).

estimated_cache_hits.description: Estimated batch size (1 cache write + `N - 1` cache reads) used to compute USD savings (default 10).

expected_output_tokens.description: Expected completion output tokens per request for budget and cost calculations (default 500).

max_context_tokens.description: Optional context window limit in tokens (defaults to the model's built-in context window).

model.description: Target LLM model identifier (e.g., gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, o3-mini, claude-3-7-sonnet, claude-3-5-haiku, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash; unknown models use generic 128K fallback).

name: tinplate_prompt_cache_budgeter
